chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (Allah) (peace be upon him), who said:
The Paradise is prohibited to the cuckold.

key_terms.الدَّيُّوثِ: The cuckold (one lacking sense of honor/ghayra)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'dayyuth' in Shia hadith and why is Paradise forbidden to him?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, the 'dayyuth' is defined not merely as a passive man but as one who tolerates indecency or lacks the protective zeal ('ghayra') for the moral integrity of his household. This hadith from al-Kafi underscores that such spiritual laxity is a disqualifying trait for Paradise, linking personal honor directly to divine reward.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah Bin Maymoun Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Paradise is Prophibited unto the cuckold’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn Faddal from ‘Abd Allah ibn Maymun who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Paradise is made unlawful for a pimp.”’
